definitions.explanation: Describes a sensation, environment, or experience that feels pleasant and soothing. Conveys a gentle, refined sense of comfort rather than mere physical ease.

examples.japanese: {心地|ここち}よい⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いている→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
{心地|ここち}よい⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれて→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦リラックス→リラックス：02531_rirakkusu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I relaxed, enveloped by pleasant music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{心地|ここち}よく、つい⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The spring sunlight was so pleasant that my walk ended up being longer than planned.

notes:
USAGE:
A slightly literary and refined alternative to ⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧ (feels good). The base noun ⟦{心地|ここち}→心地：12568_kokochi⟧ means "feeling" or "sensation" and appears in compounds like ⟦{住|す}み{心地|ごこち}→住み心地：08349_sumigokochi⟧ (comfort of living in a place) and ⟦{寝心地|ねごこち}→寝心地：07270_negokochi⟧ (sleeping comfort). When ⟦{心地|ここち}→心地：12568_kokochi⟧ appears in compounds, it is read ごこち.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心地|ここち}よい⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: pleasant breeze
- {心地|ここち}よい⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧: comfortable sleep
- {心地|ここち}よい⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧: pleasant tiredness (after exercise)
- {心地|ここち}よく⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time comfortably

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {心地|ここち}よくなかったら
